text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=infra-inference-gateway priority=P0 reason=5xx error-rate spike
incident-bot: Symptom: 5xx-rate jumped to 18% over 2m (baseline ~0.5%). Region: us-west-2. Affected route: /v1/generate. Link: https://dashboards.redwood.example/alerts/3812346000
oncall-lex: acked. I'm the current primary oncall, looking now.
oncall-lex: checking ingress counters + recent deploys. Any recent rollouts?
sre-mira: I see a canary from 03:12 that touched nginx config for keepalive and chunked-encoding. Rolling back?
eng-carol: @sre-mira that's the canary I pushed for streaming improvements. Only 10% canary. I didn't see errors in staging. Can reproduce a 502 locally with short timeouts + large payloads.
sre-mira: can you post the canary id? I'll try throttling it off the routing pool.
eng-carol: canary-id: canary-2026-03-18-03-12. The config change toggles `proxy_buffering off` and reduces `proxy_read_timeout` from 60s -> 8s.
oncall-lex: logs show repeated upstream 502s from inference-backend pods at 03:18. Error pattern: `read timeout after 8s`
incident-bot: Recent PD notes: 2 unack escalations pending if not resolved by 03:28. Escalation policy: add secondary SRE.
support-dave: Support watching customer impact: two customers reported higher latency and failed calls in the last 5m. CS ticket #CS-3421 opened.
oncall-lex: immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic away from canary pool -> remove canary from weight. 2) temporarily increase `proxy_read_timeout` back to 60s. 3) scale inference-backend by +20% autoscale override.
eng-carol: I'm rolling the canary weight -> 0 now. Pushing rollback in 10s.
eng-carol: `kubectl patch svc ingress -p '{"spec": {"traffic": [{"name":"canary-2026-03-18-03-12","weight":0}]}}'`
oncall-lex: done. Observability: can someone share the live 5xx graph?
sre-mira: https://dashboards.redwood.example/graph?panel=5xx_usw2 (short link)
sre-mira: after diverting canary, 5xx rate trending down from 18% -> 6% over 40s.
support-dave: CS: letting customers know we are mitigating; I'll update ticket and add estimated ETA 10m.
eng-carol: while diverting I also reverted nginx change in canary to previous values. Rollback applied.
eng-carol: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/ingress --to-revision=42`
oncall-lex: autoscale override applied +20% (manual).
incident-bot: PD note: page still open; ack by oncall-lex at 3812346015. Escalation prevented so far.
sre-mira: 5xx at 6% now, continuing to drop. Latency normalized for most routes. I'll monitor logs for backend OOMs or connection resets.
sre-mira: quick grep from pod logs: `ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer` around 03:18 correlated with chunked uploads.
sre-mira: hypothesis: reduced read timeout caused backend to abort long-running streaming requests -> client retries -> backend overloaded -> cascading 502s.
sre-mira: suggestion: leave timeout at 60s, increase worker threads on backend to handle spikes, and add health-check backoff.
oncall-lex: agree. For immediate safety we've reverted the canary and restored timeout. Next actions for postmortem: - RCA owner: eng-carol - follow-ups: add canary traffic validations + synthetic streaming tests, add circuit breaker on ingress to prevent cascade, update runbook.
support-dave: Notifying impacted customers in CS with a status update now.
eng-carol: I'll open the postmortem draft and add timeline. PR will include automatic gating for canary nginx toggles.
oncall-lex: handing off monitoring to SRE-mira after I log off in 15m. If error rate stays <1% for 20m, we can close the page.
sre-mira: monitoring in progress. If we see error >2% for 5m we'll re-escalate immediately.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by oncall-lex at 3812346015; escalation suppressed.
sre-mira: 5xx now 0.9% at 03:21. Marking recovery trending stable.
oncall-lex: thanks everyone. updating incident channel with summary and link to PM. :white_check_mark:
support-dave: CS updated customers; will do follow-up outreach to the two impacted accounts.
eng-carol: Postmortem link (draft): https://confluence.redwood.example/display/INC/3812346000-canary-nginx-timeout-502s
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will auto-close if stable for 30m.
sre-mira: taking watch. Ping me if anything spikes.
oncall-lex: handing off. Good job team.
